collections.title: Get Schwifty Cast
collections.description: Eight isolated character and world elements from the Get Schwifty homage. Browse them together; open, download, or share each one separately.

collections.title: Original Songs
collections.description: Finished tracks and workshop cuts generated for the JPop universe, published as compact listening copies while the full-resolution masters stay local.

collections.title: Voice Lab
collections.description: Synthetic voice auditions and local model contenders. These are generated demos, not recordings of private conversations or cloned personal voices.

collections.title: Moving Experiments
collections.description: Small generated films and audiovisual model tests that are useful as individual clips rather than as pieces trapped inside a demo reel.

collections.title: Butterfly Flair
collections.description: One subject interpreted as three print-ready visual studies: Art Nouveau, impasto, and stained glass.

collections.title: Lobster Cabinet
collections.description: A cabinet of generated crustacean art: mascots, fantasy studies, workshop imagery, and one deeply unreasonable burger.

collections.title: Industrial Afterimages
collections.description: Nine dark, photographic industrial studies made with FLUX.2 Klein 9B. Each frame stands alone and can be opened, shared, or downloaded.
